principle: Debt is multi-dimensional evidence, not a scalar score. A debt exists only where recovery/promotion/decision quality can plausibly change.

debts.name: Distillation Debt
debts.definition: Research/engineering has produced reusable structure faster than Core/Knowledge has compressed it.
evidence: 216 Computing research commits since 2026-08-05 versus a small number of Core/Knowledge promotion commits
World R8 and Human AE1/C1 are already structured research but not cross-project Knowledge/Core doctrine
debts.risk: Fresh Agents re-derive already-tested distinctions or over-read current Core as complete.
debts.treatment: OFR3-OFR6: recover theory units, then promote/narrow only after independent evidence.
debts.doNot: Do not copy every research artifact into Knowledge.

debts.name: Causal-Recovery Debt
debts.definition: A retained production invariant survives while the strongest rejected alternative, decisive falsifier, or causal reason becomes hard to recover.
evidence: Workstation execution/acquisition separation is obvious in behavior but causal pnpm 11 experiment mainly lives in Task/evidence
Host semantic continuity appears as fields/API while its negative proof boundary must be reconstructed from broader system evidence
Many exact digest/currentness fences preserve what, but not always the failed model that earned them
debts.risk: Future maintenance removes a necessary distinction or reintroduces a previously falsified mechanism.
debts.treatment: OFR3 samples high-impact invariants and reconstructs model competition + decisive failure + predicted breakage.
debts.doNot: Do not turn every code comment into a historical essay.

debts.name: Negative-Knowledge Debt
debts.definition: Rejected models and no-op/deletion results are less discoverable than surviving implementations.
evidence: Runtime sealed-memfd default rejected because semantics changed
Game Host-like aliases removed after recovery equivalence
Web spacing-only treatment failed after real rendering
PAL F15/F16 and many universal service candidates explicitly not admitted
debts.risk: Attractive old ideas are repeatedly rediscovered and re-tested without new discriminating conditions.
debts.treatment: Retain compact rejected-model records with reopen conditions and exact evidence lineage.
debts.doNot: Do not keep dead apparatus active merely to remember failure.

debts.name: Cross-Owner Convergence Debt
debts.definition: Materially different owners independently reproduce a semantic invariant but no shared synthesis records the strength, mechanism differences or transfer boundary.
evidence: Temporal non-rewriting truth recurs in Finance, Security, Workstation, Runtime/Host/World
UNKNOWN preservation recurs in Runtime, Finance, World, Security and Human review
Evidence/promotion separation recurs in World R8, Human promotion gate and Harness knowledge topology
debts.risk: Stable structure remains fragmented, or later synthesis over-promotes superficial similarity.
debts.treatment: OFR2 convergence families with independence grades and anti-pseudoreplication checks.
debts.doNot: Do not infer mechanism convergence from shared words.

debts.name: Representation-Asymmetry Debt
debts.definition: Some owners publish theory as explicit research prose while others compile equally deep knowledge into contracts/state machines with little explanatory surface.
evidence: Human/Finance/Security/World have dense research corpora; Workstation/Game/Host/Runtime often compress into canonical contracts or implementation invariants
Keyword/file counts vary by orders of magnitude without corresponding difference in epistemic depth
debts.risk: Theory discovery becomes biased toward verbose owners; low-prose owners look conceptually shallow.
debts.treatment: Census claims, not files; reverse-engineer from tests, state transitions, rejected alternatives and reopen conditions.
debts.doNot: Do not use document count or prose volume as theory maturity.

debts.name: Vocabulary / Representation Drift
debts.definition: Related distinctions acquire owner-local names whose similarity or difference is not explicitly mapped.
evidence: regime/generation/revision/epoch/currentness all encode different temporal identities
receipt/evidence/observation/support/claim/knowledge occupy overlapping but non-identical epistemic roles
capability/authority/admission/eligibility/permission/consequence differ by owner
debts.risk: False unification or duplicate abstractions; Agents may transfer a rule across the wrong semantic boundary.
debts.treatment: OFR2 records shared invariant plus mechanism/owner-specific vocabulary; OFR5 atlas later supplies crosswalks, not one universal schema.
debts.doNot: Do not normalize vocabulary by renaming owner-native objects.

debts.name: Currentness / Source-Relation Debt
debts.definition: Semantic Task history, historical experiment commits, deployed services and current owner Git can legitimately point at different revisions; the relation is often not explicit in theory summaries.
evidence: Security/Studio Host checkpoints mention later engineering commits while current canonical owner heads at the OFR freeze are 6a7a8f9... and 52f6460...
Host deployment revision differs from Host repository HEAD
World R8 deliberately froze older exact owner revisions while current owners may later advance
debts.risk: A theory document silently substitutes historical evidence for current fact or rewrites history to match present state.
debts.treatment: Every OFR asset binds current owner head plus historical evidence refs; later changes are post-freeze evidence.
debts.doNot: Do not use “latest mentioned revision” as current owner truth.

debts.name: Promotion Debt
debts.definition: A strong or recurrent result has not been explicitly tested for the correct destination: owner fact, Research prior, Knowledge explanation, Core foundation, or implementation-only invariant.
evidence: Human promotion gate itself is not systematically applied to all cross-owner candidates
Consumer downward-pressure rule has strong Game evidence but insufficient independent-domain replication
World R8 is 72/72 within its programme yet remains correctly provisional pending dogfood
debts.risk: Either under-promotion causes repeated rediscovery or over-promotion turns local success into doctrine.
debts.treatment: OFR6 later applies support maturity + falsifier + implementation-independence + cross-owner recurrence.
debts.doNot: Do not equate test count or recurrence with promotion authority.

debts.name: Theory-Use Validation Debt
debts.definition: Much retained theory has evidence for the underlying phenomenon but not for whether a compact theory representation improves fresh-Agent decisions versus raw owner inspection or current Core/Knowledge.
evidence: EX3-EX7 validates one explanation style, but OFR as a whole has not yet been held out
Human AE1/C1 establish representational sufficiency on selected cases, not broad causal attention savings
debts.risk: Foundations become elegant documentation that does not improve reasoning.
debts.treatment: OFR7 fresh-Agent baseline vs reconstructed theory vs raw repo search.
debts.doNot: Do not score theory by prose quality or internal coherence alone.

debts.name: Expression / Recoverability Debt
debts.definition: High-compression engineering knowledge is hard for humans and new Agents to reconstruct, while full historical derivation is too expensive to load.
evidence: Game intentionally retains only consumed contraction result, not Computing theory
PAL deletes apparatus after durable evidence
Core is small by design while Research history is large
debts.risk: Causal understanding decays even though implementation survives.
debts.treatment: OFR4 Theory Unit + OFR5 Atlas later preserve question, competing models, discriminating evidence, claim, non-claim, consequence and reopen condition.
debts.doNot: Do not keep all apparatus or all history in default Context.
